segments.ja230:1.1: Dhajamaparimitaṃ anantapāraṃ, duppasahaṃdhaṅkehi sāgaraṃva [sāgaramiva (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja230:1.3: Girimivaanilena duppasayho [duppasaho (sī. pī. ka.)], duppasaho ahamajjatādisena.
segments.ja230:2.1: Mā bāliyaṃ vilapi [vippalapi (bahūsu)] na hissa tādisaṃ, viḍayhase [viḷayhase (sī. pī.)] na hi labhase nisedhakaṃ;
segments.ja230:2.3: Āsajjasi gajamiva ekacārinaṃ, yo taṃ padā naḷamiva pothayissatīti.
segments.ja230:5.3: Dhaṅkamagadhā ca tayogirināma, gajaggavaro dhajavarena dasāti.
